quotes.text: It assumes that parent messages are already in the database.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Panorama currently derives a new message's thread and parent IDs from references already in the database. The code calls this an unsustainable shortcut: real mail can arrive out of order, so future threading work must resolve missing parents and must not treat this assumption as a permanent contract.
title: Do not assume Panorama thread parents already exist
